FRIENDSPIRE-EMO.title: Emo
FRIENDSPIRE-EMO.description: Gain 2 Energy on exit, or 3 with Corn Lotus.
FRIENDSPIRE-LABOR.title: Labor
FRIENDSPIRE-SIGMA.title: Sigma
FRIENDSPIRE-SIGMA.description: You deal triple damage to enemies. Return to Normal at the start of your next turn.
FRIENDSPIRE-INJURY.title: Injury
FRIENDSPIRE-INJURY.description: Each 10 stacks enters Sigma. Entering Sigma grants 3 Energy. Losing HP grants no stacks.
FRIENDSPIRE-ATTACHED.title: Inseparable
FRIENDSPIRE-ATTACHED.description: Whenever you enter Labor, draw {Amount} cards.
FRIENDSPIRE-KNIFE_GUARD.title: Knife Skills
FRIENDSPIRE-KNIFE_GUARD.description: Whenever you change stance, gain {Amount} Block.
FRIENDSPIRE-BICKERING.title: Bickering
FRIENDSPIRE-BICKERING.description: Gain {Amount} Injury at the start of your turn.
FRIENDSPIRE-LAST_TURN.title: Last Turn
FRIENDSPIRE-LAST_TURN.description: Die at the start of your next turn, even if you leave Sigma.
